description: Often referred to by its crews as a “flying FOB”, the Elated Bolide-class Assault Lander is a stout ground insertion vessel manufactured by the Etherbor PGFN Lihmona Navy Shipyard. Capable of transporting both infantry and their armored support over long distances, the Elated Bolide-class supports its landing force with a large galley, a generously sized infirmary, on-board telecommunications equipment and a plentiful reserve of combat engineering supplies. Propelled by no less than ten thrusters, not including its turbine powerplant, the Elated Bolide-class is deceptively swift for its size, a trait which has served it well through conflict and peacetime alike.
